reasoning: This appears to be a single-arm phase II study with extremely limited enrollment (n=1) that was likely terminated early. The combination of pemetrexed (antifolate) and oxaliplatin (platinum agent) has established mechanisms - pemetrexed inhibits thymidylate synthase disrupting DNA synthesis, while oxaliplatin forms DNA crosslinks. However, with only one patient enrolled and no reported efficacy or safety data, this represents a trial failure due to insufficient enrollment rather than mechanistic failure. The dose levels used (pemetrexed 500 mg/m² + oxaliplatin 120 mg/m²) are within established therapeutic ranges, suggesting the failure was operational rather than related to target engagement or biological activity.
